title: Giants' Abdul Carter lands on injury report with calf injury; John Harbaugh says LB is 'doing very well'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants' Abdul Carter lands on injury report with calf injury; John Harbaugh says LB is 'doing very well'
sources.description: Giants LB Abdul Carter missed Wednesday's practice with a calf injury, but head coach John Harbaugh did not seem concerned about it.
